sources.title: A giant spider from the Jurassic of China reveals greater diversity of the orbicularian stem group
sources.authors: Paul A. Selden, ChungKun Shih and Dong Ren
consulted_sections: Additions to interpretation of holotype female
sources.supports: Revised genus/family, comparison of sexes, plumose setae and posterior-leg interpretation. Relationships and male-female association are hypotheses, not settled living anatomy.
